svg.aria-label: About: - I build streaming apps for phones and TVs, and sometimes sneak into the backend. - React Native and JavaScript for years, React on the web of course, Swift and iOS recently on board, BUT these days, it's Claude, Claude, Claude. - I've written plenty of code and ground through plenty of algorithms, BUT now, I read more than I write. - I'm lazy, BUT I'll be super glad to automate anything annoying and repetitive, even if it takes an hour to save a second a day. - I'm great at processing, BUT bad at remembering. My brain is more like RAM. - Throw me the tricky stuff. I'm ready to level up, and open to higher pay.
svg.title: About
